results.title: Wingman 2
results.overview: When Tommi's father-in-law Johan is ordered to take a break after a medical emergency, the family decides to go on vacation to sunny Spain. However, things don't go quite as planned, and when Johan's car is stolen, Tommi and Juhis decide to take matters into their own hands, and soon our heroes are hurtling from one disaster to the next at breakneck speed.

Filled with guilt, he lived in seclusion in a small southern town, secretly protecting his comrade's daughter, Xiaodie. Xiaodie was curious about this silent neighbor, but her life took a sudden turn when she was abducted. Daqi's dormant police spirit awakened, and he embarked on a life-and-death pursuit alone.
